name: Out-of-Core Volume Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Out-of-Core Volume Rendering Pipeline — 3D+t+w Out-of-Core Rendering, FRIGAS Pipeline
definition: An adaptive pipeline for interactive visualization of large-scale 3D temporal multivariate (3D+t+w) gas and fluid datasets, managing simultaneous multivariate and temporal data without HPC systems by using out-of-core brick-based storage and on-demand GPU transfers.
